title: More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At Jiro Yakuin's high school, students are paired for a graded 'couples training' program in which they live together as if married. Introverted Jiro hoped to be paired with his childhood friend Shiori but gets Akari, a gyaru who wants the popular Minami; they cooperate to earn points and switch partners. As they pretend, real feelings grow, and a love triangle forms when Shiori admits she loves Jiro too.
life_message: It holds up learning to understand and care for a partner through everyday cooperation as the ground of real love.
